title: No physicists on NASA's follow-up UAP study

tellings.quote:
my wife and I
were approached to help with the UAP.
NASA was doing their own UAP thing

plain: A man named Charles, described as a former senior NASA figure, says that around 2023 and 2024 he and his wife were asked to help when NASA, the US space agency, was running its own study of UAP, the official term for unidentified objects in the sky. As the story is framed, that follow-up study had no physicists on it, which, if true, would suggest the agency was not taking the hard science seriously.
